Container.Name: chore-tracker
Container.Overview: Family Chore, Allowance & Rewards Tracker with Unraid persistent storage, iOS PWA support, and automated daily email reports.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Host directory for persistent chore JSON databases and backups

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Server timezone for midnight daily chore reset and scheduled digests (e.g. America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, America/Chicago)

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Optional local URL of your Unraid server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:3000) for iPhone push notification links

Config.Name: Pushover App Token
Config.Description: Optional 30-character Pushover Application API Token for instant iPhone push alerts

Config.Name: Parent Email
Config.Description: Optional parent email address for daily chore completion reports

Config.Name: Daily Report Time
Config.Description: 24-hour time for daily parent email digest (defaults to 20:00 / 8:00 PM)

Config.Name: Gmail Username
Config.Description: Optional Gmail account for sending daily digests and free SMS notifications

Config.Name: Gmail App Password
Config.Description: Optional Google 16-character App Password (requires 2FA enabled on Google account)
